canvas_256_offset.meaning: point (x, y) of the normal 256x256 canvas = (64+x, 240+y) here; draw this frame at (pet_x - 64, pet_y - 240) where (pet_x, pet_y) is the top-left of the normal 256 frame -> no position jump

ds_bubble_pop.notes: FRAMES ONLY (not in the app atlas). blow a bubble (1) -> it grows bigger than her (2) and lifts her -> floating, kicking, scared (3) -> burst at the top (4, splash) -> drop + land covered in foam (5) -> pout, shake the foam off (6) -> idle. Enlarged canvas 384x496, 256 canvas at offset (64, 240).
